correctness.rationale: Because A is invertible, V=[L,L] is characteristic; every automorphism is uniquely (c,w,T), with c nonzero, w in V and TA=cAT. Equality of characteristic polynomials restricts c to 1, or -1 exactly for odd-characteristic trace zero. Over F_{q^2}, the c=1 centralizer consists of multiplication by nonzero field elements; c=-1 intertwiners are multiplication followed by Frobenius. The norm-one subgroup counts exactly q+1 intertwiners with a one-dimensional fixed space, and all remaining ones have no fixed points; the c=1 branch is counted directly. A direct independent finite-field Gaussian elimination verifier exhausts 10 representative configurations over \(q\in\{2,3,4,5,7,11\}\) without assuming the count. Finite tests are not a general proof.
